import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        int n1 = n / 2;
        List<Integer> a1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> a2 = new ArrayList<>();

        // Generate all subset sums for the first half
        sums1(a, a1, 0, 0, n1, m);

        // Generate all subset sums for the second half
        sums2(a, a2, n1, n, 0, 0, m);

        // Remove duplicates and sort
        Set<Integer> setA1 = new HashSet<>(a1);
        List<Integer> sortedA1 = new ArrayList<>(setA1);
        Collections.sort(sortedA1);

        int ans = 0;
        for (int i : a2) {
            int target = m - i;
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(sortedA1, target);
            if (idx < 0) {
                idx = -idx - 1; // insertion point
            }
            // Check the value before the insertion point
            if (idx > 0) {
                int val = sortedA1.get(idx - 1);
                if (val + i > ans) {
                    ans = val + i;
                }
            }
            // Check the value at the insertion point, if exists
            if (idx < sortedA1.size()) {
                int val = sortedA1.get(idx);
                if (val + i > ans) {
                    ans = val + i;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static void sums1(int[] a, List<Integer> a1, int index, int sum, int limit, int m) {
        if (index == limit) {
            a1.add(sum % m);
            return;
        }
        sums1(a, a1, index + 1, (sum + a[index]) % m, limit, m);
        sums1(a, a1, index + 1, sum, limit, m);
    }

    private static void sums2(int[] a, List<Integer> a2, int start, int end, int index, int sum, int m) {
        if (index == end) {
            a2.add(sum % m);
            return;
        }
        sums2(a, a2, start, end, index + 1, (sum + a[index]) % m, m);
        sums2(a, a2, start, end, index + 1, sum, m);
    }
}
